note: Courses are TABLE DATA.  Adding one is a row here plus its two asset files under configs/speedrun/; gpuwm/speedrun.py contains no per-course branch and tests/test_speedrun.py fails if one appears.  Every field a record is compared on is hashed into the row digest, so editing a course retires its records rather than silently re-ranking them.

courses.title: Regional 12 km, six hours
courses.summary: One 178x144x49 Lambert domain at 12 km over the continental interior, six forecast hours against three-hourly global boundaries, hourly history.  The shape a first-time user's `gpuwm go` actually runs, sized so its MEASURED forecast envelope still leaves headroom on a loaded ten-gigabyte desktop card.

staged_inputs.note: f000, f003, f006 of the pinned cycle, area-subset.  The bytes are pinned by digest in every capsule; where they came from is off the clock.

courses.title: Nested 12 km parent with a 3 km child, three hours
courses.summary: A two-domain tree: an 84x68x49 parent at 12 km carrying a 168x136x49 child at 3 km, three forecast hours.  Exercises the domain-tree runner, nest initialisation and the per-nest render layout on the same card the regional course fits.

staged_inputs.note: f000 and f003 of the pinned cycle, area-subset.
